Anna often helps me with history. I like my life very much. The weekend breakfast is my favorite place. The couple next door are both doctors.
Lily drinks coffee every morning. We often go to the supermarket together. Lily and Anna are in the same class. For example, grandpa reads in his old armchair.
After school, we play together. My friend Anna is very kind. Lily's favorite season is autumn.
